_comment: Connection coordinates only. No secret of any kind belongs in this file - the user's credential is typed at login and lives in that session's memory alone, and a guard test fails the build if anything credential-shaped appears here. Port 5432 on the pooler host is Supavisor's SESSION mode, which is what this application needs: the transaction pooler on 6543 does not hold a session across statements, and both the role identity this application authenticates as and Npgsql's prepared statements depend on that session persisting.
